اعتصرا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَصَرَا (iʕtaṣarā) /iʕ.ta.sˤa.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
# اُعْتُصِرَا (uʕtuṣirā) /uʕ.tu.sˤi.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
# اِعْتَصِرَا (iʕtaṣirā) /iʕ.ta.sˤi.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
